# QR Code generator

`qrcodegen.js` is the unmodified compiled JavaScript distributed by Project Nayuki,
under the MIT license embedded in the file. It has no runtime dependencies.

- Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator
- Distributed file: https://www.nayuki.io/res/qr-code-generator-library/qrcodegen.js
- Retrieved: 2026-11-06
- SHA-256: `2511bc17f40a3c41d4a0578995db956b38997334d3d20113a5d4dc5c49c69480`

Native payment QR codes are generated locally; payment URLs are never sent to a QR hosting service.
Do not hand-edit the compiled file. Update from the upstream distribution and record its digest.
